svg.text: ◆ Default HITL: every finished goal parks in REVIEW — a human approves before delivery.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: HOOTL can skip review, but a repo goal is not auto-merged — the change stays on its branch.
